lines.text: One hundred and eighty-nine countries. One world war. I simulated it one thousand times.
Simulation number one. Every country attacks a neighbor. Bigger armies have better odds... but anything can happen.
The smallest armies fall first... and the big ones start to grow.
Half of the world is already gone. The biggest empire right now: the USA.
Only fifty countries left. Now the big armies start to collide.
Only ten countries left. From now on, every battle counts.
The final! Colombia attacks Russia.
Russia wins simulation number one! That is one win. Nine hundred and ninety-nine to go.
Now... let's run it nine hundred and ninety-nine more times.
After one thousand world wars... one hundred and thirty-two countries never won. Not even once.
The strongest army that never won? Taiwan. one hundred and seventy thousand six hundred soldiers... and China eliminated it four hundred and forty-five times.
And fifteen countries won exactly one time.
But the biggest surprise of all... Tajikistan. Only eight thousand eight hundred soldiers. The smallest army ever to win.
Simulation number two hundred and ninety-three. Tajikistan attacks... China.
Its chance of winning: zero point zero five percent. About one in two thousand...
And it wins! With the army of China, Tajikistan becomes a superpower.
In the final, Tajikistan takes on the USA...
Tajikistan conquers the entire planet!
The most common final? China versus the USA. It happened twenty-three times.
Now... the top ten countries that won the most wars.
Number ten: Pakistan. twenty-one wins.
It reached the final thirty times. Its worst enemy: China, which eliminated it two hundred and seventy-four times.
Number nine: Ethiopia. twenty-two wins.
It reached the final sixty-three times. Its worst enemy: Eritrea, which eliminated it two hundred and eleven times.
Number eight: Egypt. thirty-one wins.
It reached the final fifty-five times. Its worst enemy: Ethiopia, which eliminated it one hundred and fourteen times.
Number seven: Ukraine. thirty-four wins.
It reached the final sixty-one times. Its worst enemy: Russia, which eliminated it two hundred and fifty times.
Number six: Iran. thirty-six wins.
It reached the final fifty-two times. Its worst enemy: Pakistan, which eliminated it one hundred and fifty-one times.
Number five: North Korea. eighty-five wins.
A tiny country with a giant army. But China eliminated it three hundred and thirty-four times.
Number four: Russia. ninety-eight wins.
And its worst enemy is... North Korea. two hundred and three times!
Number three: the USA. one hundred and nineteen wins.
The USA reached the final two hundred and one times... but it lost eighty-two of them.
Number two: India. one hundred and thirty wins.
It reached the final one hundred and fifty-eight times. Its worst enemy: China, which eliminated it two hundred and forty-one times.
And number one: China. two hundred and seven wins.
One in every five world wars. And it reached the final two hundred and thirty-one times.
Which country do you think deserves number one?
